name: Aris Mining Corporation
description: Aris Mining Corporation is a Canadian gold producer operating the Segovia and Marmato underground gold mines in Colombia, which together produced approximately 257,000 ounces of gold in 2025. The company is a growth-stage producer targeting over 500,000 ounces annually as it commissions a second mill at Segovia and advances the Bulk Mining Zone at the Marmato Complex toward production in 2026.
